claims: The Artemis II crew successfully splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II crew completed their 10-day mission around the Moon.
Footage shows the Artemis II capsule's parachute deployment and recovery.
Coverage of the Artemis II capsule's parachute deployment and recovery is available on NASA's YouTube channel.
Coverage of the Artemis II capsule's parachute deployment and recovery is available via AP News.
FOX 10 Phoenix provides footage of the Artemis II splashdown in the Pacific Ocean.
PBS NewsHour offers live-streamed coverage of the Artemis II reentry and splashdown.
NASA+ provides official high-quality streams of the Artemis II final landing moments.
KCRA 3 provides full video coverage of the Artemis II capsule reaching the ocean surface.
The Artemis II crew's safe return completes the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
